title: Academic Task 2: Weakest-Skill Repair and Transfer Retest
prompt: In many universities, students who fail a core academic skill in their first year are offered a short intensive repair course before they are allowed to continue their studies. Some educators argue that this approach helps students recover quickly, while others believe it merely delays deeper problems and that universities should instead provide long-term support throughout the degree. To what extent do you agree or disagree that short intensive repair courses are the best way to help students who fall behind in core academic skills? Give reasons for your answer and include any relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先明确你的立场（完全同意、部分同意或不同意），再在正文中说明短期强化补修课程的优点与局限，并解释为什么长期支持可能更有效或更无效。你需要讨论双方观点并给出自己的判断，用具体理由和例子支撑，不要只描述现象。建议写至少250词，注意段落结构与论证连贯性。
